LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_Description: Set target stocks for Helod resources and intermediate parts. All planning desks share this map's plan. Deficits add the largest fitting batch to an existing suitable workbench; workers need the usual materials, research, facilities and power. Manual bills and unfinished batches count as pending. A target of 0 turns that item off. Select an item to see its production flowchart.
LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_PerUnit: Quantities are for one unit of the selected item. Materials flow left to right. Click a box to fold or unfold its inputs; drag to pan.
LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_TreeLimit: Only the first {0} boxes are shown. Fold branches or open an input on its own.
LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_SelectItem: Select an item on the left to see its production flowchart.
LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_RawTip: No recipe makes this. It is mined, harvested, traded, or supplied another way.
LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_CycleTip: This item already appears further along this chain, so it is not unfolded again.
LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_NotPlannable: Its only recipes are emergency conversions, so it is not planned automatically. Queue it manually.
LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_ManualOnlyTip: The planner never queues this recipe automatically.
LanguageData.HD_ProductionPlanning_Status: Unstarted surplus orders are removed when stock arrives or targets fall. An already-started batch finishes. Removing the last desk or disabling planning pauses its bills and preserves unfinished work.
